movers.headline: closes its **qualified institutions placement at Rs 1,890 a share**, a 2.96% discount to the Rs 1,947.70 floor price and the largest raise on the tape

signs a **Ministry of Defence contract to supply Satellite Smart Anti-Airfield Weapons to the Indian Air Force**, for delivery between 2027-28 and 2028-29
wins **Rs 797 crore of power transmission and distribution orders**, comprising tower and monopole exports to Australia and a domestic 765 kV line

movers.quantum: Rs 297.50 cr including GST, Rs 273.19 cr excluding; ~9.5% of mcap

movers.quantum: up to Rs 272.34 cr; 10,17,123 swap shares at Rs 1,460 plus up to Rs 123.84 cr cash
movers.headline: signs a **share purchase agreement for up to 100% of Winwin Speciality Insulators at Rs 141.88 a share**, subject to an EGM on 19 October

movers.quantum: Rs 177.35 cr including taxes; ~4.6% of mcap
movers.headline: receives a **firm purchase order from Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses for satellite communication equipment**, to be executed by March 2027

movers.quantum: Rs 153.76 cr excluding GST; ~9.8% of mcap
movers.headline: secures a **POWERGRID notification of award for the 400 kV Tumkur-II AIS extension substation package**, on a 21-month execution schedule
receives a **work order for piling work from a domestic company it does not name for competitive reasons**, to be executed over nine months

movers.quantum: Rs 29.51-30.17 cr excluding GST; ~30.6% of mcap
movers.headline: receives **three domestic purchase orders for 1.975 million metres of shirting and finished fabric**, which it puts at about 98.75% of its annual capacity

order_wins: **Bharat Dynamics** - signs a **contract with the Ministry of Defence worth Rs 810.79 crore to supply Satellite Smart Anti-Airfield Weapons and associated equipment to the Indian Air Force**, a DRDO-designed glide bomb with 60% indigenous content, for delivery between 2027-28 and 2028-29 _(~1.9% of mcap)_.

**Skipper** - secures **fresh orders of Rs 797 crore for domestic and international power transmission and distribution projects**, comprising export orders for transmission towers and monopoles in Australia and a domestic 765 kV transmission line from an unnamed developer _(~12.6% of mcap)_.

**Oswal Pumps** - receives a **Letter of Intent from Telangana Renewable Energy Development Corporation to design, supply and commission 46,705 kW of rooftop solar across 9,937 government schools in 33 districts**, with five years of maintenance; Rs 297.50 crore including GST, Rs 273.19 crore excluding _(~9.5% of mcap)_.

**Avantel** - receives a **firm Rs 177.35 crore purchase order including taxes from Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses for satellite communication equipment** with a one-year onsite warranty, drawn against a rate contract awarded in March 2026 and to be executed by March 2027 _(~4.6% of mcap)_.

**Vikran Engineering** - wins a **Rs 153.76 crore notification of award excluding GST from POWERGRID for the 400 kV Tumkur-II AIS extension substation package**, including civil works for a 300 MVAR STATCOM, to integrate 2.7 GW of renewable capacity over 21 months _(~9.8% of mcap)_.

**Indo Tech Transformers** - receives a **Rs 42.88 crore Letter of Award plus GST from Leap Green Energy Group for four 125 MVA transformers**, two in the 400/33 kV class for a solar project and two at 230/33 kV for a wind project _(~1.2% of mcap)_.

**One Point One Solutions** - secures a **Rs 39.32 crore customer-experience Centre of Excellence mandate from an unnamed leading power utility**, covering contact-centre operations, physical experience centres, back office and digital service from its Navi Mumbai and Indore delivery centres.

**Suntech Infra Solutions** - receives a **Rs 37.00 crore work order for piling work from a domestic company it withholds for competitive sensitivity**, to be executed over nine months _(~50.4% of mcap)_.

**Tuni Textile Mills** - receives **three domestic purchase orders for 1.975 million metres of shirting and finished fabric from Disha Clothings, Northakross Syntex and Sharda Corporation**, Rs 29.51-30.17 crore excluding GST, which it states is about 98.75% of its annual manufacturing capacity _(~30.6% of mcap)_.

**Accord Transformer & Switchgear** - receives a **Rs 20.02 crore Letter of Award excluding GST for 57 wind-turbine transformers of 3.6 and 5.5 MVA for Aditya Birla Renewables' Bhuj-1 and Bhuj-2 projects**, from an unnamed private EPC contractor, for delivery in four to five months _(~15% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**Accord Transformer & Switchgear** - separately reports **Rs 5.28 crore of cumulative material purchase orders excluding GST taken since 14 September**, the largest being 17 purchase orders worth Rs 4.48 crore of inverter-duty transformers for Good Earth Renewable Services.

**Rajputana Biodiesel** - and subsidiary Nirvaanraj Energy **receive Letters of Intent from Hindustan Petroleum for 740 kilolitres of biodiesel each at Jaipur and Meerut, about Rs 13.72 crore including GST**, for supplies covering June to August 2026 _(~9.8% of mcap)_.

**Sheetal Universal** - receives an **export order of USD 1.22 million from Beacon Star General Trading, Dubai, for 1,000 tonnes of red-skin peanut kernel at USD 1,220 a tonne**, which the filing puts at about Rs 11.53 crore, to ship within a month.

**Subex** - is **chosen by a major Asia-Pacific mobile network operator to modernise its partner ecosystem management**, consolidating voice, messaging, data, 5G and IoT wholesale onto one mediation, billing and settlement platform; USD 5 million over five years, extendable by two.

**BCPL Railway Infrastructure** - bags a **Rs 6.22 crore Letter of Acceptance including GST from Eastern Railway's Howrah division to replace overaged and rusted cantilever assemblies**, to be completed in 18 months _(~5.4% of mcap)_.

**Euphoria Infotech** - receives a **Rs 4.03 crore work order from West Bengal undertaking Webel Technology to run the state's undergraduate online admission portal** for the 2026-27 academic session, over seven months _(~50% of mcap)_.

**Dhruv Consultancy Services** - receives a **Rs 3.79 crore Letter of Award excluding GST from Maharashtra's Public Works Division, Panvel**, to prepare a detailed project report and feasibility study for widening 249.20 km of road under multilateral development bank funding, over 365 days.
**Oriental Rail Infrastructure** - wins a **Rs 3.64 crore order from Integral Coach Factory, Chennai** to manufacture, supply and install 40 coach sets of chairs, for delivery by 8 November.
**Desco Infratech** - receives a **Rs 2.34 crore purchase order including GST from Adani Total Gas** for MDPE pipeline laying and last-mile connectivity work at Navsari _(~1.6% of mcap)_.

**Fusion Klassroom Edutech** - receives a **Rs 1.35 crore order from an unnamed Bengaluru company to produce educational video content** across artificial intelligence, machine learning, banking and finance courses, running to 31 March 2027.

**GHCL** - is **declared preferred bidder in Gujarat's e-auction for a composite licence over the Kadaya limestone block in Junagadh**, 6.8797 hectares holding 5,67,337 tonnes of reserve; the Letter of Intent follows only on performance security within 45 days.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Bharat Forge** - closes a **qualified institutions placement of 1,05,82,010 equity shares at Rs 1,890**, a 2.96% discount to the Rs 1,947.70 floor, raising Rs 2,000 crore on our arithmetic; the issue opened on 17 September.

**Prime Focus** - board approves **Multiples Private Equity investing USD 100 million in material subsidiaries Brahma AI Holdings and Brahma AI Services India** through compulsorily convertible preference shares, USD 54.36 million of it into Brahma AI Holdings, subject to shareholder approval.

**Oscar Global** - board approves a **Rs 13.21 crore cash preferential issue of 1,32,06,400 shares at Rs 10 to Alok Rajesh Nanavaty and Pie Strategies LLP**, part of a 4,77,16,400-share allotment put to an EGM on 20 October.

**Healthy Life Agritec** - board approves **raising up to Rs 50 crore through a rights issue of partly paid-up Rs 10 equity shares** and forms a rights issue committee; price, entitlement ratio and record date are all still to be set.

**Party Cruisers** - **revises its rights issue down to 19,98,318 shares and Rs 23.98 crore from 20,00,000 shares and Rs 24.00 crore** by corrigendum, and reschedules the issue to open on 29 September and close on 13 October _(~20.3% of mcap)_.

**Kellton Tech Solutions** - board approves **raising funds by a rights issue of Re 1 equity shares** to existing shareholders; issue size, price, entitlement ratio, record date and issue period are all left to be determined.

**California Software** - **extends to 9 October the last date for the first and final call of Rs 7.50 a share on partly paid rights shares**, on shareholder requests, with all other terms of the call unchanged.
equity_allotments: **Kalyani Cast-Tech** - allots **3,23,123 convertible warrants at Rs 582, Rs 18.81 crore**, having received Rs 4.70 crore as the 25% upfront subscription; a fresh preferential allotment, not a conversion _(~2.1% of mcap)_.

**Remi Edelstahl Tubulars** - allots **8,33,331 equity shares at Rs 180, Rs 15.00 crore, to promoter-group entities Hanuman Freight and Skyrise Mercantile and three non-promoters**; the accompanying convertible warrants were not issued because one proposed allottee did not pay _(~4.5% of mcap)_.

**Kirloskar Electric** - allots **34,68,007 equity shares at Rs 115.34, Rs 40.00 crore, to promoter-group Kirloskar Power Equipments**, lifting its holding to 6.60% from 1.73%, and separately closes its 2015 Master Restructuring Agreement with the Bank of India consortium _(~5.0% of mcap)_.

**PC Jeweller** - allots **1,18,52,500 equity shares to promoter and managing director Balram Garg on conversion of warrants**, against the balance Rs 16.00 crore being 75% of the warrant issue price; a past conversion, not new capital.

**Aurique** - allots **98,38,200 fully convertible warrants at Rs 12 to two allottees, Vandanaben Patel of the promoter group and public shareholder Sureshkumar Patel**, in a first tranche with 25% received upfront and no change yet in paid-up capital.

**Ken Enterprises** - **adds promoter-group entity Zest Performancewear as an allottee of 39,94,000 of the 39,97,000 warrants** in its Rs 16.19 crore preferential issue approved on 5 September, leaving the number, the Rs 40.50 price and every other term unchanged.

**Qualitek Labs** - **substitutes Jagattaraini Tieup for Vibha Singhi as the allottee of 16,000 shares** in the preferential issue approved on 22 September, in which Ashish Kacholia takes 1,73,200 of the 3,86,000 shares; all other terms unchanged.
m_and_a: **Quality Power Electrical Equipments** - signs a **share purchase agreement for up to 1,91,95,007 shares, or 100%, of Winwin Speciality Insulators at Rs 141.88 a share, up to Rs 272.34 crore**, settled through up to 10,17,123 swap shares at Rs 1,460 and up to Rs 123.84 crore of cash, subject to an EGM on 19 October.

**Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals** - signs a **business transfer agreement to buy Group Pharmaceuticals' wellness portfolio by slump sale**, Rs 23.7 crore on closing plus up to Rs 23.0 crore linked to FY28 sales and capped at Rs 46.7 crore, to complete by 1 November; the portfolio turned over Rs 24.6 crore in FY26 _(~3.1% of mcap)_.

**Euro Pratik Sales** - board approves acquiring a **56% controlling stake in Fabwood Solutions, which is to own the Fab Wood timber and engineered-wood business, for Rs 42.70 crore** including Rs 8.40 crore of fresh capital, to close by 8 October _(~1.9% of mcap)_.

**Power Grid Corporation** - **acquires project SPV Barmer HVDC Power Transmission from RECPDCL** having won the tariff-based competitive bid, taking on 6,000 MW of 800 kV HVDC terminals at Barmer-II and South Kalamb and a roughly 1,000 km bipole line across Rajasthan, Gujarat and Maharashtra.

**REC** - wholly-owned RECPDCL **transfers both its project SPVs on receipt of consideration: Barmer HVDC Power Transmission to Power Grid and Sakoli Power Transmission to Ashoka Buildcon**, the successful tariff-based competitive bidders; neither remains a REC subsidiary.

**Ashoka Buildcon** - signs the share purchase agreement and **acquires 100% of Sakoli Power Transmission, a nil-turnover build-own-operate-transfer SPV, from RECPDCL for Rs 3.06 crore**, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary.

**Waaree Energies** - board approves the **draft scheme amalgamating Indosolar into Waaree Energies** under Sections 230 to 232, subject to both exchanges, the NCLT and the shareholders and creditors of each company.

**Oscar Global** - board approves **acquiring 100% of Calculus Travel Ventures from JBCG Advisory Services for a share swap of 3,45,10,000 shares at Rs 10, Rs 34.51 crore**, taking the travel-technology company on as a wholly-owned subsidiary.

**IRB InvIT Fund** - **executes the share purchase agreement to buy 100% of Solapur Yedeshi Tollway and CG Tollway from the sponsor-linked IRB Infrastructure Trust**, a related-party purchase unitholders approved on 3 August; the two road SPVs turned over Rs 306.59 crore between them in FY26.

**Ravindra Energy** - board approves the **scheme amalgamating Energy In Motion into Ravindra Energy**, the transferor having reported FY26 turnover of Rs 1,806.88 million and a net worth of Rs 823.27 million, subject to the exchanges, SEBI, the NCLT and shareholder and creditor approvals.

**Mukta Arts** - executes **shareholders and securities subscription agreements under which investor Sunil Shamrao Patil will put up to Rs 10 crore into subsidiary Mukta A2 Cinemas**, diluting Mukta Arts to between 49% and 42% and turning Mukta A2 into an associate rather than a subsidiary.

**Lemon Tree Hotels** - receives **no-objection observation letters from both exchanges for its composite scheme of arrangement** folding in Fleur Hotels, Carnation, Hamstede Living and four other group companies, clearing the way to the NCLT.

**Niyogin Fintech** - the **NCLT Chennai allows the first-motion application for its scheme demerging into Niyogin Finserv and amalgamating iServeU Technology**, directing shareholder and creditor meetings and dispensing with three others.

**ICICI Prudential Life Insurance** - the Registrar of Companies **approves its renaming to ICICI Life Insurance Limited** with effect from 22 September, with a fresh certificate of incorporation issued; an application to IRDAI follows.

**D & H India** - executes an **agreement to buy 70,094 square metres of leasehold industrial land at Mohana Industrial Park, Indore, from DP Polymers & Chemicals for Rs 18.00 crore**, for capacity expansion and product diversification _(~9.3% of mcap)_.
capex_core: **Exide Industries** - material subsidiary Exide Energy Solutions **completes commissioning of Phase-I, a 6 GWh lithium-ion cell manufacturing plant at Devanahalli, Bengaluru**, built for multiple chemistries and form factors across mobility and energy storage.

**Maxvolt Energy Industries** - holds the **ground-breaking for a proposed 10 GWh lithium battery pack campus at Aligarh**, which its own event material sizes at Rs 700 crore across two 5 GWh phases, the first targeted in 24 to 30 months; the plant is proposed, not under construction.

**Grasim Industries** - **subscribes Rs 234.99 crore for 23,15,27,093 equity shares at Rs 10.15 in subsidiary Aditya Birla Renewables**, a preferential private placement flagged in July; money deployed into a subsidiary, not raised.

**Clean Science and Technology** - **subscribes Rs 50.00 crore for 8,36,121 shares at Rs 598 in the rights issue of wholly-owned Clean Fino-Chem**, the sixth such infusion since 2022, to fund that subsidiary's projects _(~0.6% of mcap)_.

**Wonder Electricals** - board approves **buying Onkar Engine and Generator's geyser manufacturing plant, excluding land, for about Rs 16.50 crore plus tax**, financed by bank borrowing and adding 20% to a 25,000-unit monthly capacity running at 40-50% _(~1.6% of mcap)_.

**Orient Green Power** - subsidiary Delta Renewable Energy **commissions 17.60 MW AC, or 24.64 MW DC, of solar in Tiruvannamalai district**, taking installed solar capacity to 24.6 MW AC and completing the expansion committed under its 2024 rights issue.
**Prostarm Info Systems** - **completes installation and trial runs at its relocated facilities and sets a schedule to start operations**, following intimations running back to April.
business_updates: **Results season** — 29 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Max Estates** - signs a **binding memorandum of understanding for a joint development agreement over a 9.76-acre parcel in Indirapuram, Ghaziabad**, envisaging 1.5 million sq ft and a gross development value of Rs 2,500-3,000 crore on a capital-light revenue-share; it is subject to due diligence, approvals and execution of the JDA.

**Raymond** - subsidiary JK Maini Global Aerospace **emerges successful in a tender from an Indian aerospace and defence OEM to assemble wing and centre-fuselage structures for a major indigenous fighter programme**, its entry into aircraft structures; no value is disclosed and the work uses the customer's own plant.

**GMR Airports** - subsidiary GMR Hospitality is **selected to develop and run the food and beverage outlets at Delhi airport's Terminal 3 to May 2036**, on a revenue share with fellow subsidiary DIAL that it estimates at Rs 49 crore of licence fees in FY27 and Rs 109 crore in FY28; the filing calls it a related-party transaction.

**Chandan Healthcare** - reports its **diagnostic franchise network has passed 500 centres, out of 568 in total as of 15 September**, and targets 1,000 by the end of FY27 and 3,000 within two more years; about 80% of the franchises are in Uttar Pradesh.

**Glenmark Pharmaceuticals** - receives the **US FDA Establishment Inspection Report for its Goa formulations plant with Voluntary Action Indicated status**, closing out the inspection conducted between 22 and 30 June.
credit_rating_changes: **Vadilal Enterprises** - **India Ratings downgrades its bank facilities to IND A- from IND A+ on the long term and to A2+ from A1+ on the short term**, and places both on Rating Watch with Negative Implications.
**Vadilal Industries** - **India Ratings places its IND A+ and IND A1+ bank facilities on Rating Watch with Negative Implications**, without changing either rating.

**Steel Exchange India** - **Infomerics upgrades Rs 198.56 crore of debentures and Rs 359.63 crore of long-term bank facilities to IVR BBB+/Stable from BBB-/Stable**, and the short-term rating to IVR A2 from A3.

**JSW Infrastructure** - **CARE upgrades subsidiary JSW Jaigarh Port to AA+/Stable from AA/Stable on Rs 600 crore of long-term facilities and a Rs 135 crore long- and short-term line**, reaffirming the A1+ short-term rating.

**SBFC Finance** - **CARE reaffirms AA- and revises the outlook to Positive from Stable** across Rs 6,000 crore of long-term bank facilities, enhanced from Rs 2,500 crore, and Rs 400 crore of debentures, with the Rs 200 crore commercial paper reaffirmed at A1+.

**Oswal Pumps** - **ICRA reaffirms its A+ rating but revises the outlook to Negative from Stable**, citing a substantial build-up of receivables and weaker profitability on competition and input costs, and does the same for subsidiary Oswal Solar Energy.
**Salasar Techno Engineering** - **Infomerics reaffirms its IVR A and IVR A1 ratings and places both on Watch with Negative Implications**, across Rs 831.73 crore of bank facilities.
distress_risk: **Sasken Technologies** - the **GST appellate authority in Bengaluru dismisses its appeals for FY21 and FY22 and confirms the demands**, Rs 14.45 crore including recalculated interest for FY21 and Rs 10.90 crore for FY22, on reverse-charge tax.

**Supriya Lifescience** - a court **allows provisional release of a detained 200 kg consignment of ketamine hydrochloride against a Rs 72 lakh deposit**, while expressly leaving adjudication and criminal proceedings under the NDPS Act to continue.
**Sapphire Foods India** - receives a **show-cause notice from the Deputy Commissioner (Commercial Taxes), Chennai**.
